operating_principle: Manage dAimon as a trust product from the first commit: every task has a proof target, every claim has a boundary, and every release has validation.

cadences.name: Session Start
steps: Read README.md, docs/full_orchestration_plan.md, and current roadmap phase.
Check git status before editing.
Identify whether the active task touches local continuity, MongoDB, Google Cloud, demo assets, or release operations.
State expected proof artifact before implementation starts.

cadences.name: Daily Build Loop
steps: Pick the highest-value roadmap phase blocker.
Implement the smallest coherent proof-producing increment.
Run required validation group from orchestration/test_matrix.json.
Update docs or sample outputs when behavior changes.
Commit with a message that names the proof gained.

cadences.name: Settlement Review
steps: Identify candidate outputs and their domain.
Check template proof obligations.
Decide accepted, accepted_with_caveats, rejected, deferred, needs_human_review, needs_more_proof, merged, or archived_as_witness.
Issue or update receipt.
Update inheritance bundle only from accepted receipt-backed objects.

cadences.name: Integration Gate
cadences.frequency: before using external services in claims
steps: Confirm required credentials are present locally or in GitHub Secrets.
Run readiness check.
Execute the smallest live proof.
Save redacted proof artifact.
Record non-claims for anything not proven live.

cadences.name: Release Candidate
cadences.frequency: before demo submission or shared milestone
steps: Run local scaffold and orchestration validations.
Run live MongoDB proof if the release claims MongoDB integration.
Run Google Cloud proof if the release claims hosted Google infrastructure.
Run Agent Builder or Gemini proof if the release claims live carrier handoff.
Run demo claim audit.
Record known gaps and non-claims.

cadences.name: First Contact Pairing
cadences.frequency: when a public GPT or new carrier creates a project lane
steps: Create project-bound first contact package.
Record project ID as routing identifier only.
Issue first contact receipt.
Require pairing secret or local hub proof before bounded local packets.
Record allowed action scope.

cadences.name: Voice Packet Gate
steps: Record transcript source and risk phrase matches.
Classify high-risk phrases as possible transcription ambiguity.
Pause for confirmation or restatement when required.
Issue clarification receipt.
Route only confirmed or low-risk packets.

cadences.name: Security Lab Gate
cadences.frequency: before any high-risk or red-team scenario
steps: Confirm scenario is bounded to lab resources.
Use synthetic secrets and sandbox targets.
Record containment boundary and detector expectations.
Run scenario only after containment is explicit.
Issue containment receipt and re-test requirement.

work_lanes.name: Continuity Kernel
definition_of_done: Behavior is covered by local validation.
Receipts cite proof and excluded witness is retained.

work_lanes.name: Integrations
definition_of_done: Credentials are referenced by name, not value.
Live proof artifact exists when integration is claimed.

work_lanes.name: Product Surface
definition_of_done: UI or docs make accepted, rejected, deferred, and needs_review states visible.
Claims separate proven behavior from roadmap.
Release evidence is easy to inspect.

work_lanes.name: Demo Package
definition_of_done: Every claim maps to an artifact or non-claim label.
Storyboard shows the trust failure mode and the governed solution.
Final package includes claim audit receipt.

work_lanes.name: Continuation And Identity
definition_of_done: Project identity is separated from full user identity.
Portable packages include receipt-cleared context and excluded witness.
Voice-derived high-risk actions are gated by confirmation receipts.

work_lanes.name: Fabric And Security
definition_of_done: Adapters declare capability, authority, proof, and risk.
Cross-surface paths preserve lineage before inheritance.
High-risk tests run only inside explicit containment lanes.

repo_rules: Treat .env as local contest configuration only.
Keep dAimon independent from the ION repository while preserving protocol lineage in docs.
Prefer proof-producing increments over broad unvalidated rewrites.
When a claim cannot be proven yet, mark it roadmap or non-claim.
